sources.locator: Implementation Decisions / Description d'une tâche et zone pertinente

criteria.expected: Use the immutable task origin, width, height and cardinal normal; frame layers include its plane.
criteria.observation: Task and declared frame layers
criteria.coverage: static
criteria.diagnostic: Frame layers anchored to immutable passage, independent of physical construction.

criteria.expected: Frame faces a cardinal direction; skydoors are excluded by alpha.
criteria.observation: Task normal
criteria.coverage: static
criteria.diagnostic: DOOR cardinal orientation; skydoor is outside alpha.

criteria.expected: Rectangular regular arrangement with task width and height, measured inside frame; no universal depth inferred from the linked face image.
criteria.observation: Declared layer(s) and rectangular occupancy
criteria.coverage: static; other regular shapes remain indeterminate
criteria.diagnostic: Closed rectangular occupancy is required; an open snapshot cannot prove the closed arrangement. Rectangular task cross-section and declared frame layers; +Z task basis implemented. Depth is declared explicitly, not prescribed by an image.

criteria.expected: No door block inside the frame when open, all closed door blocks inside when closed.
criteria.observation: Frame layer occupancy, independent of rest
criteria.coverage: static pattern only; stability separately required
criteria.diagnostic: Snapshot occupancy/collision pattern; this does not establish a stable state.

criteria.expected: Door blocks are quartz-like, including preserved functionality after quartz substitution.
criteria.observation: Closed frame block properties; canonical quartz is identity substitution
criteria.coverage: static canonical quartz; non-quartz substitution needs behavioral evidence
criteria.diagnostic: Quartz identity substitution is conclusive; opaque movable nongravity alternatives require behavioral substitution proof. Open geometry cannot infer closed door material.

criteria.expected: Physical walls, floor and ceiling enclose the fixed frame; they are distinct from the interior cross-section.
criteria.observation: Perimeter collision of declared layer(s); Dummies index 9641
criteria.coverage: static inward collision faces; unusual shapes indeterminate
criteria.diagnostic: Physical perimeter at fixed passage; collision faces covering the inward wall/floor/ceiling side prove enclosure. Unusual partial shapes are not forbidden, but need traversal evidence.

criteria.expected: Fixed entrance pattern extends in either normal direction without colliding with wiring.
criteria.observation: All observed blocks on passage rays, including positions outside declared layers; Dummies index 5274
criteria.coverage: snapshot plus temporal influence coverage required
criteria.diagnostic: No observed obstruction on fixed passage rays beyond frame layers; tracked static wiring region permits indefinite continuation beyond its extents. Transient completeness assessed separately.

criteria.expected: Quartz-like hallway and air defaults are optional for this alpha without SUPER/FULL SEAMLESS.
criteria.observation: Collision and wiring assessed separately; no mandatory quartz wall or air-id whitelist
criteria.coverage: not an alpha restriction; source exception index 3852
criteria.diagnostic: Optional quartz/air composition outside SUPER/FULL SEAMLESS; no strict air-id or wall-material requirement.

criteria.expected: A supported button or lever on a lateral exterior surface has constant support; input block remains wiring.
criteria.observation: Validated live input declaration; alpha forbids top/bottom attachment
criteria.coverage: input tool integration
criteria.diagnostic: Live declaration is read from Inputs, never accepted as caller-supplied evidence; top/bottom placement is invalid.

criteria.expected: Alpha excludes constructions using entities.
criteria.observation: Entities within observed construction bounds
criteria.coverage: presence fails conservatively; absence limited to tracked influence bounds
criteria.diagnostic: Entities within tracked construction bounds; absence is not a universal influence certificate.

criteria.expected: Alpha excludes a permanently running internal clock required for operation.
criteria.observation: Transition/rest behavior, not an invented component blacklist
criteria.coverage: transition proof required; snapshot cannot determine necessity
criteria.diagnostic: Requires operational transition proof; no component blacklist or frozen-state inference.

criteria.expected: The requested open/closed pattern is stable until the next input.
criteria.observation: Transition/rest certificate
criteria.coverage: not inferred from a frozen snapshot
criteria.diagnostic: This tool observes a snapshot; bounded transition/rest protocol supplies stability evidence.
